items.en_oneliner: A public buyer in Rio de Janeiro (RJ) is procuring supplies, equipment or consumables through government procurement procedure, with an estimated value of about R$ 937,500, so interested SMEs should check the eligibility and document requirements on the official PNCP notice page early.
